formattedAddress: 108, Taiwan, Taipei City, Wanhua District, Ximen Village, Hanzhong St, 103號2 樓

text.text:
We almost missed Joyful Restaurant because the entrance is literally inside a phone case shop beside Xin Fu Tang. Walk in, go upstairs, and suddenly there’s a full pasta place.

Now I understand why Taipei has so many pasta spots. It’s not the super traditional Italian style, but honestly it works. The pasta is al dente and the flavors are very Asian-friendly.

We ordered the carbonara and the spicy seafood pasta and both were really good, but the spicy seafood was the winner for me. So flavorful with just the right kick — the kind of dish that makes you want to come back again.

Skip the burgers and drinks o👀

From start to finish, the lunch experience was outstanding.

Each dish was expertly prepared and full of rich, authentic flavors.
The restaurant offers a warm and comfortable ambiance, complemented by genuinely welcoming and attentive staff who enhance the overall experience. Every bite was a pleasure, and I left thoroughly satisfied. I would confidently recommend this place to anyone looking for exceptional Italian food in Taipei.

text.text: Had a wonderful experience at Joyful (揪福)! The Carbonara was excellent—rich, creamy, and seasoned perfectly. We also loved the snack platter with crispy onion rings and loaded fries. The service was great, and the staff made us feel very welcome throughout our meal. Highly recommend for a tasty and relaxed lunch!

This was a quite a delicious surprise . The burgers  are juicy and good size . I would say tho maybe give the burger patty a bit more of a grill crust . However it was big and juicy. The wings  were delicious as well, crispy and really moist and juicy.
The price is affordable too for Ximen .
